node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one full-trace cancellation
node.statement: The automatic order-one root x_0=-1/(c-1) contributes identically to every star and inverse m-power trace because c_star-1=zeta/(c-1), zeta^m=1, and m is even. Hence the first r reduced reciprocal equations are exactly the first r full-P trace equalities. The first-three system can be generated from the original degree-h polynomial without division by the known root or construction of Qtilde.
node.notes: Exact representation reduction inside the proved order-one Frobenius gate. It removes the quotient-division representation, not the parameter elimination or any pointwise outer/inner condition.
